about_the_game:
Embark on a grand journey through a home filled with warmth, mysteries, and charming details. A meditative immersion into a world of cozy locations and puzzles, where a story unfolds at its own leisurely pace.

Dozens of handcrafted scenes, brimming with light and coziness, await you. You will explore every nook and cranny: from a cluttered yet homely attic that smells of old wood and memories, to a perfect, bright garden where every blade of grass and every bug is drawn with love. This is not just a search for objects; it's an attentive stroll through a world you'll want to savor.

The game's mechanics are built on the principle of relaxed exploration. There are no timers—just you, calm music, and complete freedom of action.

In addition to the main search, your path will be blocked by witty mini-games and varied puzzles that will help you uncover the secrets of this special place.

The main reward for your attentiveness is the opportunity to arrange your own ideal space. Collect unique items of interior and decor to fill cozy rooms with character and warmth, creating the house of your dreams where every item was found by you.


In the demo version, you will experience:

  • Exploration: 12 lively, detailed locations with no time limits.

  • Relaxing atmosphere: Immersive music and graphics that ease tension.

It's the perfect way to spend an evening, immersed in a story where every found item becomes a part of a big and kind fairy tale.
